description: This file defines models, utility functions, and code completion configurations for custom actions in the Thingsboard UI, including functions to convert widget actions into custom action descriptors and setup code completion objects.

methods.name: toCustomAction
methods.description: Converts a WidgetAction into a CustomActionDescriptor, providing default samples if necessary.

methods.name: toPlaceMapItemAction
methods.description: Creates a CustomActionDescriptor for place map items, using default samples if specific properties are undefined.
